## Which outcome would this session target?

<!--
After each call we ask attendees whether the session met the outcomes below.
Tick every outcome your session would aim to support.
Most sessions target one or two, so choose the ones that matter most.
-->

- [ ] **Building RCM capacity:** This session will provide me with skills, tools, or practices I can apply in my own community work.
- [ ] **Building an RCM network:** This session will connect me with others who can support my community work.
- [ ] **Facilitating the RCM ecosystem:** This session will strengthen my ability to describe or advocate for RCMs as a professional role, to myself, my team, or my organisation.
